items.q: Do you help new sellers get started?
items.a: Yes. We handle registration, GST and documentation guidance, catalogue setup and your first campaigns.

items.q: What does the free audit include?
items.a: A review of your listings, keywords, pricing, ads and account health, plus a short list of the fixes that will move sales fastest.
We offer monthly management plans based on the number of marketplaces and SKUs. Message us for a quote that fits your store.
